biography: Full Professor of Soil (Agricultural) Chemistry at Alma Mater Studiorum University of Bologna (UniBO), Department of Agricultural and Food Sciences (DISTAL); Teaching activities: Soil fertility and Plant nutrition, Management of soil fertility, Agricultural biochemistry and soil fertility, Use and recycling of biomasses; Academic positions: - 2015-2018- Dean, School of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine - UniBO; - 2016–2017 Past President of the Italian Society of Agricultural Chemistry; - 2014–2015 President of the Italian Society of Agricultural Chemistry; - 2012–2013 President Elect of the Italian Society of Agricultural Chemistry; - 2010-2012 Coordinator of the PhD Program in "Agricultural, Environmental and Food Science and Technologies" - UniBO; - 2007-2012 Head of the Ph.D. School in "Agricultural Science" - UniBO; Research activities: His scientific activities are focused on soil chemistry and biochemistry: i) characterization of soil organic matter (humic substances), humic and humic-like substances of organic fertilizers, organic amendments, compost and other organic wastes paying particular attention to both agronomical and environmental implications; ii) agronomical valorization of organic wastes of agro-industrial origin related to the key role in plant nutrition and closure of nutrient cycles in soil; iii) dynamic of organic matter and nutrients in soil: mineralization of organic carbon and nitrogen (kinetics); iv) soil quality and functions: microbial biomass, enzymes activities mainly involved in the dynamic of nutrients. Publications: He is author of more than 250 publications most of which published in peer-reviewed journals. Scopus (September 25th, 2022): H-Index 36, Citations 3761 on 135 articles surveyed; http://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.url?authorId=7003277305 Google Scholar (September 25th, 2022): H-Index 43, Citations 5796, i-H10-index 104 on 282 articles surveyed; http://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=list_works&hl=en&user=PBfpH7MAAAAJ Referee of scientific peer reviewed Journals: Agriculture, Ecosystems and Environment, Biology and Fertility of Soils; Chemosphere; Clean - Soil, Air, Water , Environmental Science and Technology; European Journal of Agronomy; European Journal of Soil Science; Geoderma; Journal of Agriculture and Food Chemistry; Journal of Analytical Applied Pyrolysis.; Journal of Arid Environments; Journal of Chromatography A; Journal of Environmental Quality; Journal of Environment Science and Technology; Journal of Hazardous Materials; Journal of Management and Waste Resources; Journal of Soil and Sediments Contamination; Waste Management; Soil Science Society of America Journal. Member of Scientific Societies: 2020 April – to date: Board Member of the Italian Academy of Agriculture 2016- to date: Corresponding academic resident, Academy of Sciences of the Bologna Institute (Section III - Biological, Animal and Plant Sciences) 2016-2017: Past President, Italian Society of Agricultural Chemistry - SICA 2014-2015: President, ItalianSociety of Agricultural Chemistry - SICA 2012-2013: Vice President Elect, Italian Society of Agricultural Chemistry - SICA 2015, December 15th – to date: Academic Ordinary of the Italian Academy of Agriculture 2010 – December 14th, 2015: Academic Corresponding of the Italian Academy of Agriculture 2004-2012: Member, “Board of Directories” of the International Humic Substances Society - IHSS. 2004 – to date: Member of the Committee B. "Soil organic matter and organo-mineral interaction", Soil System Science (SSS), European Geosciences Union (EGU) 2003 – to date: Member of the Scientific Board of Archives Agronomy & Soil Science 1993-1997: Secretary-Treasurer, Italian Society of Agricultural Chemistry - SICA. IHSS, SICA, IUSS, SISS Ministerial appointments: 2016 up to date: Advisor CEN/TC 260/WG 8 – “Organic and organo-mineral fertilizers”. 2011 November-2017: Advisor in Brussels (European Commission - DG Growth): "Fertilizer Working Group" and "Regulatory Committee on Fertilizers. 2000-to date: Member of the Sub-Commission for Official analytical methods of fertilizers (MiPAF) 1994-to date: adviser member of the Italian Fertilizer advisor committee.
